title: Does Cutting a Banana Make It Sweetlier?

scenes.text: Cut a banana and taste a sweeter bite?
Many believe that slicing a banana releases extra sugars.
scenes.label: Slicing adds sugar

scenes.text: Bananas contain starch that converts to sugar as they ripen; cutting doesn’t accelerate this process, it only exposes the existing sugars.
scenes.label: Ripening converts starch

scenes.text: Only ripeness matters, not the cut!
scenes.label: Ripeness > Cutting
scenes.sub: Sugar level set by fruit age.

scenes.text: Hit follow for your daily dose of wow.

description: Debunking the idea that a knife can sweeten a banana. Learn the real science behind fruit ripening.
